verdict.rationale: New Relic ships an official MCP server (documented Nov 2025) that connects AI development tools to New Relic's platform context, including converting plain-English questions into NRQL queries. This is first-party vendor documentation with a dedicated release note and probe-confirmed URL, but lacks independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server's reliability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on validation of the MCP server, detail on setup/auth flow and supported tool integrations.
